name: New Lead — 7-Touch
description: The fortune is in the follow-up. Most sales need 5+ touches; this keeps a fresh lead from going cold in the first two weeks.

steps.title: Text — 'Nice to connect, here's my info'
Call #2 — no answer? try different time of day

name: Estimate Follow-up
description: After the estimate is presented. Silence is not a no. Stay in front of them until you get a decision.

steps.title: Call — walk through the estimate, handle objections
Call — address #1 concern, ask for the business
Call — decision check, offer to hold their spot

name: Cold Revive
description: Re-engage an old or stalled lead. Low pressure, give them a reason to re-open the conversation.

steps.title: Email — recent job nearby + offer a fresh look

name: Referral Partner Nurture
description: Keep realtors, HOAs, insurance agents, and property managers sending you business. Relationships need regular touches.

steps.title: Call — check in, ask about their current listings/clients
Coffee / lunch — stay top of mind
Email — recap referrals closed + thank you
